text: Hello, boys and girls.It's me, Scarlett again.Welcome back to my class.Now please get your student's book and the worksheet ready.In today's class, we are going to learn to make a flow chart.And then we will turn it into a paragraph.Are you ready?Let's go!Do you remember the flow chart?Look familiar, doesn't it?What is it about?Yes, it's about waterdrop's journey.What shape is the flow chart?It looks like a circle, doesn't it?When we need to show sets of actions arranged one after another and forming a circle, we can use flow chart like this.We call it circular flow chart.Have you seen other types of flow charts?Look at this flow chart.You are also familiar with it.But this one is a little bit different from the one we did in the last lesson.What is this chart about?It's about Shanghai's water.How do you know what the flow chart is about?From the title, right?Now please take out your worksheet and try to complete the flow chart about Shanghai's water.It's task one.Okay, time is up.Let's have a check.After water goes to a water treatment works, where does it go?It travels in pipes under the street.Then it comes out of the tap and runs down the drain.The flow chart is complete now.Look at the flow chart again.How many steps are there in the chart?There are seven, right?Flow charts show how things are done step by step.And how are the steps displayed in this flow chart?Are they arranged in a circle?No, the flow chart presents steps from top to bottom.This vertical flow chart, 縱向流程圖, is one of the most common types of flow chart.Sometimes we can see flow chart like this.It has different shapes and symbols.Different symbols have different usages.流程圖有不同的符号组成,它们有不同的作用。Look.We can use an oval 椭圆 to show start or end point.A rectangle 长方形 is usually used to show each step of the process.And we use arrows 箭头 like these to connect the steps.And the diamond 零形 here, it indicates we should make a decision here.这种流程图我们在九年级讲投诉的时候可能会用到哦。This time, let's look at the language in the flow charts.Are the words in the steps written in complete sentences?No, they are written in note form, right?Flow charts only show key information.This makes it easy to read and understand.Words in note form can help us get the most important information in the process.When we need to give a presentation, to plan a project, or to complete a task, we can try flow charts at the very beginning.Flow charts can be a useful tool to explain a process, to arrange things, and to organize our thoughts.When I plan my lesson, I always use a flow chart to outline and organize my thinking process.Now, it's time for you to create a flow chart.Imagine you are 25 years old.Make a flow chart of your life from the time you were born up to your 25th birthday.Pick up the most important stages in your life, no more than six, and display them in the flow chart.Use note form instead of sentences.Try some symbols!One more thing, what tense should we use?Past tense, good.Go and create your own flow chart.The task is on your worksheet, task two.The task is on your worksheet, task three.The task is on your worksheet, task four.The task is on your worksheet, task five.终于完成了,让我们来看看Sherry的流程圈在Sherry的流程圈中,她出生,然后在5岁学习录音,很棒!在10岁,赢得了一场录音比赛,恭喜!在11岁,学习在中学生学校在19岁,学习在大学然后,学习在22岁最后一步,学习在25岁,她喜欢学习你觉得她的流程圈怎么样?她关注了流程圈的特征,例如用户,每一步的用户,并且流程圈是在时间计划中安排的。现在是什么时间?既然这个课程是关于水,我想让你与它有关的另一个流程圈。看看,它是关于什么?是的,它是关于如何让水流通过木材。您选择了什么流程圈和为什么?琳达,您有什么想法?我选择了圈圈的流程圈。您的意思是圈圈的流程圈,对吗?The word recycle means no start and no end.Very good, because the steps need to be arranged one after another, and they form a circle.Look at the words in the box.Do you remember the meaning of root, trunk and branches?It means 树根、树干和树枝。Please use these words to make a flowchart showing how water recycles through trees.And the word cloud has been done for you.Make it in task 3 on your worksheet.Then tree root and tree trunk.Great!Then tree branch, tree leaf and vapor.Perfect circle, isn't it?Can you develop the flowchart into a paragraph?What do we need to do when we develop the chart into a paragraph?Sherry, what's your idea?We need to use sentence.Yes, instead of words in note form, we need to use sentences to describe each step.Anything else?We need to use some words to show order.What kind of words can you give some examples?Like first, second, then finally.Right, we can use some sequence words to connect each step.Or we can use adverbial clauses introduced by when, after, etc.Now, you are going to write a paragraph of about 60 words to explain how water recycles through trees.Take good use of the flowchart you made just now and pay attention to verb tense.You will have 3 minutes.This time, you will evaluate the work by yourself.Complete the self-checklist of your writing.A star will be given to you for each yes.Full stars mean excellent work.Check it by yourself.Okay, how many stars can you get?Let's read Sherry's paragraph and see how many stars she can get.Let's read her work first.Let's read Sherry's work first.Does she describe the whole process?YesDoes she use linking words like sequence words or adverbial clauses?YesOkay, can you find them?After, then, when, finally, great.What do you think of her verb choice?I like it very much.She describes different steps with different verbs.How about tense?Does she use proper tense?Yes, but simple present tense, right?How many stars can she get?4, excellent job.Today's homework.Make a flow chart of an experiment with the help of the pictures on your homework sheet.Then write a paragraph of about 60 words to explain the process.Use the simple past tense.That's all for today's class.See you next time.Thank you for watching.
